set.body: Create R/null_spec.R defining S3 class neurothresh_null_spec with fields: stat_vol, mask, draw, n_perm, df, kind, meta. Add validators and a coerce helper. Rename factories: make_null_fun_voxel_signflip -> null_voxel_signflip, make_null_fun_mc_fwhm -> null_mc_fwhm, make_null_fun_mc_acf -> null_mc_acf, make_null_fun_subject_signflip -> null_subject_signflip, make_null_fun_onesample -> null_one_sample, make_null_fun_twosample -> null_two_sample. Add new null_parcel_perm() factory that returns a null_spec for hier_scan's parcel-level permutation. All factories must return a neurothresh_null_spec object (no more bare functions, no more list with $null_fun). See specs/api-consistency-plan.md §2.
set.title: [apicon] Phase 1: null_spec class + factory rename
